title: Chance of visible red hair, by number of MC1R gene copies

source.name: MC1R recessive inheritance of red hair
source.publisher: Standard human genetics (textbook Mendelian recessive-trait inheritance)

notes: Red hair is a classic recessive trait: one copy of a red-hair MC1R variant does not produce visible red hair (the person is a silent carrier); it takes two copies, one inherited from each parent, for the trait to show.
